annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1231 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1231 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision of 11 June 2026 updating the list of harmonised standards supporting the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745. It adds and replaces references to standards on biological evaluation, symbols, electrical equipment, prosthetics and others, conferring presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Annex to Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 listing harmonised medical device standards.
Publishes references to new and amended EN ISO/IEC standards, conferring presumption of conformity under MDR.
Withdrawal of previous versions deferred: from 15 December 2027, and 15 June 2031 for EN ISO 15223-1:2021.
Enters into force on the day of publication.
